context.person: A person using an online exam platform
context.user_goal: Review the duration and report any mismatch before starting.

product_state.current_state: The exam duration changed from 90 to 135 minutes. The exam date and start window are unchanged.
known_facts: The exam duration changed from 90 to 135 minutes.
The exam date and start window are unchanged.
The instructor can see that an accommodation was applied but not its medical basis.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product confirmation so the person can understand exam accommodation confirmed, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Report an accommodation mismatch before the exam.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The approved duration is now 135 minutes while other scheduling details remain unchanged.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Review the duration and report any mismatch before starting.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
